paragraphs: Friend, here's the big idea: Jesus moves on God's timing, not on anybody's pressure. His brothers pushed Him to go public, and their advice sounded smart. Jesus told them, "My time has not yet come" (John 7:8). He wasn't being slow or shy, because He knew when the right moment was (John 7:6).

Here's why that matters to you, baker. Some voices around you will have a loud plan and a good pitch, and they won't know what God is doing. John says even His own brothers did not believe in Him (John 7:5). Jesus stayed steady anyway, and He never let the crowd set His schedule. When you feel rushed to prove yourself, I'd say that's the time to slow down and check with the One who knows the hour.

And look at the crowd at the end. Some said, "He is a good man." Others said, "No, He deceives the people" (John 7:12). Folks have been arguing about Jesus ever since, and they still do. So don't just go with the whisper in the room. Go to the Word and see Him for yourself, and keep that oven warm while you do.
